name: lib_matrix_rank_smul
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (m n : Type*) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (c : K) (hc : c ≠ 0) (M : Matrix m n K) : Matrix.rank (c • M) = Matrix.rank M
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (m n : Type*) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (c : K) (hc : c ≠ 0) (M : Matrix m n K), Matrix.rank (c • M) = Matrix.rank M
informal: Scaling a (rectangular) matrix over a field by a nonzero scalar does not change its rank: rank (c • M) = rank M. Promoted from Mathlib2.bld_involution_trace_rank_aux1 (also re-proved as bld2_tripotent_rank_split_aux1 and bld2_involution_iff_rank_add_rank_aux1); generalised from square to rectangular matrices.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (m : Type u_2) (n : Type u_3) [Fintype m] [inst_2 : Fintype n] (c : K), c ≠ 0 → ∀ (M : Matrix m n K), (c • M).rank = M.rank
